name: AI工具集 (AI Bot)

sources.title: Homepage — large live Chinese AI tools directory (1000+ tools, daily updates, ICP-licensed)
About — documents two paid inclusion tiers: 文章收录 ¥99 (permanent article) and 网址收录 ¥399 (permanent homepage listing), 48h delivery via WeChat

requirements: AI tools and AI-related websites only — directory is all-AI categories (writing, image, video, office, agents, chatbots, coding, design, audio, search, dev platforms)
Two paid inclusion services: ¥99 article listing (permanent, in 最新AI项目) or ¥399 URL listing (permanent, on homepage 最新收录) — both include an outbound link and a written intro
Explicit rejection of low quality: '不收录套壳、镜像、低质量网站' — no wrappers, mirrors, or low-quality sites
Payment handled via WeChat — scan the QR code and reply '产品收录'; delivery within 48 hours including copywriting and publishing
preparation: Product materials for the editors to write the intro (name, URL, description, screenshots)
A WeChat account — payment and contact go through a WeChat QR code
¥99 or ¥399 RMB budget depending on placement
Chinese-language product description strongly recommended — audience is Chinese
workflow: Read the 广告合作/关于我们 pages for the inclusion terms
Scan the CakeGrowth WeChat QR code and reply '产品收录'
Pay ¥99 (article) or ¥399 (homepage URL listing) and send product materials
Editors write and publish the intro within 48 hours — article in 最新AI项目, or URL card on the homepage 最新收录 section
For unpaid suggestions, email info@ai-bot.cn — site accepts 'AI工具提交' via email but inclusion is not guaranteed
watchFor: Entirely Chinese-language site and workflow — WeChat payment is the only documented channel
No guaranteed free route — email submissions are welcome but paid tiers are the documented service
Site warns of copycat/imitation domains — only ai-bot.cn is official
Both tiers are 'permanent' one-time payments, not subscriptions
Non-Chinese products are accepted (directory covers 国内外 tools) but a Chinese description helps
countsAsLive: The tool has an intro page or card on ai-bot.cn — either in /the-latest-ai-projects/ (article tier) or the homepage 最新收录 block (URL tier)
unknowns: Whether emailed free submissions ever get listed without payment
Exact payment channel details before scanning the QR code
Whether the outbound link is dofollow
